text: The purpose of this report is to provide an update to the Infrastructure and Environment Committee regarding the number of automated enforcement devices including Automated Speed Enforcement and Red Light Camera violations issued to City of Toronto vehicles, in addition to providing the information requested by the and Environment Committee on January 11, 2022. Fleet Services provides the City of Toronto with comprehensive, efficient and responsive asset management to support the delivery of public programs and services. In addition to acquiring and maintaining vehicles, we train, upgrade and monitor over 11,000 operators of City vehicles and equipment. Our services include: - Establishing guidelines for safe driver operations - Ensuring safe fleet operations through equipment operator and related training - Ensuring compliance with the provisions of the Highway Traffic Act As part of…
